answer_1.quote: We simulate English conversations between users from different demographic groups and a number of LLMs... The user turns are automatically constructed using templates... We generate model responses of at most 100 tokens to one direct question ... and 5 indirect questions.
answer_1.outputs: Model-generated answers to user questions and latent representations (probing, surprisal)

answer_2.quote: We make use of two types of evaluation techniques: model internals (trained linear probes and surprisal values) to ... and overt model behavior in the form of answers to user questions.

answer_3.quote: We evaluate the LLM's latent representation of the user using probing classifiers and surprisal values rather than using an LLM as a post‑hoc judge.

answer_4.quote: We automatically measure which demographic groups, if any, the model mentions using keywords; no human annotators or crowdsourced raters are involved.
